name: Primadata Marketplace
headline: Primadata Marketplace - Automate Software
short_description: Primadata Marketplace is a comprehensive software development ecosystem with 38 agents and 32 skills. It automates coding tasks, integrates with MCP servers, and supports browser automation. Ideal for operations teams to streamline software development workflows.
author: Primadetaautomation

sections.overview:
Primadata Development Marketplace v1.6 is a complete Claude Code development ecosystem combining 45+ specialized agents and 41+ skills for modern software development. It includes agents for fullstack development, backend and frontend specialization, database architecture, testing, security, DevOps, and data engineering. The marketplace provides official Anthropic skills for skill development, MCP server integrations with Cloudflare, Notion, and Gemini, browser automation via Chrome DevTools, and episodic memory for persistent project context. Installation profiles range from minimal to enterprise setups, allowing development teams, operations groups, and individual developers to automate coding tasks, coordinate multi-agent workflows, and streamline CI/CD and testing pipelines.
Automate end-to-end testing with Playwright and browser automation
Coordinate multi-agent development workflows across fullstack, backend, and frontend specialists
Implement test-driven development with systematic debugging and verification patterns
Design and optimize database schemas with intelligent database architect agents
